Vendored third-party files, unmodified, checked in so the app runs from static files with no build step and no runtime npm dependency.

Both files below are licensed under the Apache License 2.0, not this repository's own MIT license — see `LICENSE-Apache-2.0.txt` in this directory for the full text (identical for both; it's the standard Apache 2.0 boilerplate). Neither vendored file is modified from its published form, so no "changed files" notice is needed under the license's redistribution terms.

`versions.json` in this directory tracks the currently-vendored version of each package — it's the source of truth `scripts/update-vendored-deps.js` reads/writes, not the prose below.

- `dexie.mjs` / `dexie.d.mts` — Dexie, copied from `node_modules/dexie/dist/dexie.mjs` and `dexie.d.ts` (renamed to `.d.mts` so TypeScript pairs it with the `.mjs` file automatically).
  - Copyright (c) 2014-2017 David Fahlander. The package ships a `NOTICE` file (required to be relayed under Apache 2.0 §4(d)); its full text: "Dexie.js / Copyright (c) 2014-2017 David Fahlander / Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0 (the "License"); you may not use this file except in compliance with the License. You may obtain a copy of the License at http://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0 / Unless required by applicable law or agreed to in writing, software distributed under the License is distributed on an "AS IS" BASIS, WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY KIND, either express or implied. See the License for the specific language governing permissions and limitations under the License."
- `passwordless-client.mjs` / `passwordless-client.d.mts` — Bitwarden Passwordless.dev client SDK, copied from `node_modules/@passwordlessdev/passwordless-client/dist/esm/passwordless.mjs` (unminified, matching Dexie's precedent) and `dist/passwordless.d.ts` (renamed to `.d.mts`). Drives the browser-side WebAuthn ceremony only; server-side calls to Passwordless.dev's REST API from the Worker use plain `fetch`, no SDK.
  - Copyright 2023 Bitwarden Inc. (from `LICENSE.txt` in the [source repo](https://github.com/bitwarden/passwordless-client-js) — the npm package itself only publishes `dist/`, so the license file isn't in the installed package; confirmed against the GitHub source instead). No `NOTICE` file exists in that repo, so there's nothing to relay beyond the license itself.

**To upgrade either one:** run `node scripts/update-vendored-deps.js` — it installs each package's latest version, copies the same files listed above, and updates `versions.json`. Running it is a no-op (no git diff) if nothing's changed upstream. The `.github/workflows/update-vendored-deps.yml` workflow runs this on a weekly schedule and opens a PR only when it actually produces a diff — the PR still needs human review before merging, same as any vendored code change (this is deliberately not an auto-merge, given one of these two files drives a security-sensitive WebAuthn ceremony).
